---
title: "Testing, build and release"
---

## Contract-boundary testing

Tests should verify parity generically where possible: every registered capability is discoverable by presets/protocols, representable to ODK, and able to project every declared output without changing names/types/semantics.

High-value behavioural checks include live result preservation, tap-to-copy, Commit payload freezing, post-commit actions, binary URI grants, final-byte hashing, preset runtime-input policy, launch-origin closeout and orientation/state preservation.

## Capability promotion

Before promotion, exercise dashboard presence, direct run, native preset, protocol selection, ODK invocation/return, example XLSForm where possible, copy/share/save, and capability-specific UI quality.

## Standard commands

```bash
./gradlew :app:testDebugUnitTest
./gradlew :app:assembleDebug
```

## Git hygiene

MethodMesh worktrees may be busy. Inspect status, stage only the coherent intended change and do not delete/reset broad areas without explicit confirmation. Release notes describe what happened; they do not redefine architecture.
